profile.name: RsInstrument SCPI仪器控制组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于通过 VISA/SCPI 远程连接和控制实验室仪器。它提供资源发现、命令读写、OPC同步、错误查询、二进制数据传输、仪器文件传输、日志与会话管理等功能，适合在自动化测试与测量流程中作为通用仪器通信层使用。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for remotely connecting to and controlling laboratory instruments over VISA/SCPI. It provides resource discovery, command read/write, OPC synchronization, error querying, binary data transfer, instrument file transfer, logging, and session management, making it suitable as a general instrument communication layer in automated test and measurement workflows.
